description: Mã quyết định xử phạt cá nhân — PK duy nhất (Bảng Tác nghiệp). Driving Table: Penalty Decision Subject (penalty_decision_subject) — nguồn track draft DataModel/working/Atomic/lld/ThanhTra/lld_ThanhTra_PENALTY_DECISION_SUBJECT.yaml, chưa approved. Filter: subject_tp_code = 'INDIVIDUAL' (khác Nhóm 8 dùng ORGANIZATION).
Số định danh cá nhân bị xử phạt — merge key với Individual Profile (ETL, không phải FK Atomic).

etl_logic: JOIN penalty_decision ON penalty_decision.pd_id = penalty_decision_subject.pd_id AND penalty_decision.src_stm_code = 'ThanhTra.PENALTY_DECISION' -> penalty_decision.decision_nbr

description: Ngày ban hành quyết định xử phạt.
etl_logic: JOIN penalty_decision ON penalty_decision.pd_id = penalty_decision_subject.pd_id AND penalty_decision.src_stm_code = 'ThanhTra.PENALTY_DECISION' -> penalty_decision.issued_dt

description: Nội dung vi phạm. JOIN Penalty Decision Subject Behavior -> Violation Behavior.
etl_logic: JOIN pd_subject_behavior ON pd_subject_behavior.pd_subject_id = penalty_decision_subject.pd_subject_id AND pd_subject_behavior.src_stm_code = 'ThanhTra.PENALTY_DECISION_SUBJECT_BEHAVIOR' -> JOIN violation_behavior ON violation_behavior.violation_behavior_id = pd_subject_behavior.violation_behavior_id AND violation_behavior.src_stm_code = 'ThanhTra.VIOLATION_BEHAVIOR' -> violation_behavior.violation_behavior_nm
source_entity: Penalty Decision Subject Behavior / Violation Behavior

description: Hình thức xử phạt chính — Penalty Type WHERE penalty_category_code = 'PRIMARY_PENALTY'.
etl_logic: JOIN pd_subject_behavior ON pd_subject_behavior.pd_subject_id = penalty_decision_subject.pd_subject_id AND pd_subject_behavior.src_stm_code = 'ThanhTra.PENALTY_DECISION_SUBJECT_BEHAVIOR' -> JOIN penalty_type ON penalty_type.penalty_tp_id = pd_subject_behavior.penalty_tp_id AND penalty_type.src_stm_code = 'ThanhTra.PENALTY_TYPE' AND penalty_type.penalty_category_code = 'PRIMARY_PENALTY' -> penalty_type.penalty_tp_nm
source_entity: Penalty Decision Subject Behavior / Penalty Type

description: Trạng thái quyết định. LEFT JOIN Violation Case qua Penalty Decision.violation_case_id (NULL nếu chưa có Violation Case).
etl_logic: JOIN penalty_decision ON penalty_decision.pd_id = penalty_decision_subject.pd_id AND penalty_decision.src_stm_code = 'ThanhTra.PENALTY_DECISION' -> LEFT JOIN violation_case ON violation_case.violation_case_id = penalty_decision.violation_case_id AND violation_case.src_stm_code = 'ThanhTra.VIOLATION_CASE' -> violation_case.life_cycle_status_code
